description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to process container management within the WPEFramework, including network interfaces, memory and processor info, container iteration, and container control functionalities.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over network interfaces of a container, providing methods to get interface name, number of addresses, and specific IP address.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface providing memory usage statistics for a container, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface providing CPU usage statistics for a container, including total usage, per-core usage, and number of cores.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Interface representing a container, providing methods to get container ID, PID, memory and CPU info, network interfaces, and control methods to start and stop the container.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over multiple containers, providing access to container IDs.

classes.name: IContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton interface for managing container instances, including creation, retrieval, and logging configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all created containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, returning nullptr if not found.
